heroHeadline: Ocean Cleanup Expands to LA Rivers; Copenhagen Study Reveals Hidden Coral Kill Mechanism
heroSubtitle: The Ocean Cleanup and Kia announced a May 2026 expansion of Interceptor technology to the Los Angeles River and San Gabriel River ahead of the LA28 Olympics, extending the 30 Cities Program to one of the U.S. West Coast's largest plastic-emitting urban waterways. A University of Copenhagen study published May 21 in Science Advances identified a new thermal kill mechanism in corals — warming oceans collapse microscopic surface cilia before any bleaching appears, suggesting corals are more thermally vulnerable than current monitoring captures. Nearly 200 conservation groups continued opposing H.R. 8509, which has White House backing to delay ropeless fishing gear requirements until 2035, threatening the ~380 surviving North Atlantic right whales.
